newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO's Solana hails summit outcome.
newsitem.headline: NATO's Solana hails summit outcome.

text.p: NATO Secretary General Javier Solana said on Friday that the U.S.-Russia summit was a major step forward in developing a more secure and peaceful Europe,
An official statement issued by NATO said Solana was "especially encouraged" by Russian President Boris Yeltsin's commitment to conclude a deal with the Alliance in the near future.

Solana, who is negotiating a pact between NATO and Russia to go hand in hand with the Alliance's eastwards expansion, is due to meet Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov for more talks next month.

NATO officials said that although there was no deal on enlargement at the U.S.-Russia summit in Helsinki on Friday it appeared Yeltsin had been assured his country would not be left out of a new post-Cold War security order.
"The secretary general welcomes the many positive results of the Helsinki summit," the statement.
